## What

A retained `lint-as-committed` Git checkout is ready for a mutation probe only after its owner marker (`.git/lint-as-committed-owner.json`) publishes `dependencyMode: "independent-copy-v1"`. A clean Git status and an existing root `node_modules` directory do not establish dependency preparation.

## Why it matters

EI-28825003081944948 initially appeared to be a selected-workspace copy omission. The exact historical creation log (`.papercusp/scratch/bash-0a60c200-818.log`) instead records full-scope `--materialize-only --ref=2161852760bb05873975f4f40a6db5bedfab9b72`, creates the reported `3HqcoJ` clone, misses the generation selector, completes only the root dependency tree, and exits 143 during donor copying. The later probe driver accepted that tree using only root-directory existence and clean Git status. Workspace-local dependencies were still missing when collection imported tracing. The reason that preparation received SIGTERM is not established.

The readiness marker is written atomically by `prepareIndependentNodeModules` only after copying, workspace builds, and link validation. `mutation-probe.sh` now checks that marker for the subject's and caller's marked roots before retaining source or starting a baseline. Missing and unrecognized modes produce `reason=committed-dependencies-incomplete`.

## How to apply

Finish a successful maintained materialization before reusing a clone. If interrupted, use the runner's supported resume-verification route and require its terminal completion; do not promote a partial tree because root dependencies exist. Keep incomplete trees available for recovery. Do not hand-write the readiness marker. For a missing package report, recover the exact clone's creation log and scope before proposing workspace-selection changes; a different clone at the same commit is not equivalent evidence.

## Evidence

The canonical `mutation-probe-script.test.ts` regression exercises missing and unrecognized modes from both subject and cwd roots with root dependencies present. Before the fix, ledger `23940967` records four failures because the probe incorrectly executes the guard. Afterward, ledger `23940972` records six passing focused cases, including prepared retention and ordinary-guard positive controls. The separate full/selected nested-generation regression remains ledger `23940933` (four cases). These are focused local verdicts, not a full-suite or deployment claim.
